reason: Both plans satisfy the checklist items, but A strictly honors the backup-before-modification rule by taking the full production backup (step 5) before any step that alters production for replication (step 6), whereas B builds the logical-replication pipeline on production (step 3, which requires publication/replica-identity changes on the source) before its first full backup (step 4), violating the explicit ordering requirement. A also states clearer reasoning for why CDC replication is used instead of a straight dump given the 2 TB size and 2-hour window.
